name: Summer Arts & Music
description_short: A full-day music and arts program in Boston for ages 5–11. It runs Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm, in four one-week sessions in July. Each week follows a different musical theme, and families can sign up for one week or all four.
refund_policy_summary: All participants pay a one-time $50 registration fee that cannot be refunded. The page does not give refund terms for tuition.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Summer Arts & Music - Community Music Center of Boston

warnings: This page only shows the summer 2026 season, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). Dates and prices for 2027 have not been posted.
Only the July 6 start date is given. The dates for Weeks 2-4 were worked out by assuming four back-to-back Monday-Friday weeks in July.
Sliding-scale prices ($162.50-$650 per week) depend on family income. Every family also pays a $50 registration fee.
The school's accreditations are from music and arts school bodies, not the American Camp Association (ACA).
